# tidycensuskr.sf
District boundaries by censal years for `tidycensuskr` package

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.path = "man/figures/README-",
  out.width = "100%"
)
```

This package is a companion package for `tidycensuskr`. It provides district boundaries by censal years for South Korea.


## Installation
```r
install.packages("tidycensuskr.sf", repos = "https://sigmafelix.r-universe.dev")
```

An up-to-date version can be installed from GitHub with:
```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("sigmafelix/tidycensuskr.sf")
```

## Usage
`load_districts()` is the main function to load district boundaries. ADM2 and ADM3 boundaries are available through 2025. The 2025 ADM2 boundary is based on the 2025 second-quarter vintage from the Statistical Geographic Information System (SGIS), reference date 2025-06-30. The default `year` is 2020. Note that the geometries are provided in the form of `sf` objects in coordinate reference system (CRS) 5179 (Korea Central Belt 2000). The data were purposely simplified to reduce file size and improve visualization performance. The simplification process may have resulted in some loss of detail in the boundaries.

```{r load_2020}
library(tidycensuskr)
library(tidycensuskr.sf)
library(sf)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Load 2020 district boundaries
adm2_2020 <- load_districts(year = 2020)
head(adm2_2020)
plot(st_geometry(adm2_2020))

# Load ADM2 boundaries as of 2025-06-30
adm2_2025 <- load_districts(year = 2025)

```


## Data source
The district boundaries are sourced from the Statistics Korea (KOSTAT) website. The original data were simplified to reduce file size and improve visualization performance. The simplification process may have resulted in some loss of detail in the boundaries.
